FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 340
Committee: Children and Senior Advocacy Sponsor: Representative Kenneth Paschal
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 03/18/2025
REVISED
House Bill 340 as introduced would increase the administrative obligations of the Alabama
Department of Human Resources (DHR) by requiring the department to provide written notice
of due process rights and provide copies of all departmental documents pursuant to an
investigation. Further, this bill would increase obligations of DHR by a department-estimated $1
million annually, beginning in Fiscal Year 2026, to establish a training program for employees
and investigators pursuant to the provisions of this bill.
